description: This file manages kernel memory domains, including initialization, partition management, thread association, and architecture-specific hooks within the Zephyr RTOS kernel.

methods.name: k_mem_domain_init
methods.description: Initializes a memory domain with specified partitions.

methods.name: k_mem_domain_add_partition
methods.description: Adds a partition to a memory domain.

methods.name: k_mem_domain_remove_partition
methods.description: Removes a partition from a memory domain.

methods.name: k_mem_domain_add_thread
methods.description: Associates a thread with a memory domain.

methods.name: z_mem_domain_exit_thread
methods.description: Removes a thread from its memory domain during teardown.
